about: How rig-control's window shows this workflow (rig-control trials.py and window). The window computes performance, water and licks from BonsaiData_Trial and BonsaiData_Async; the workflow computes none.

TrainingStage.help: The task file's stage: 0 is the first, both spouts and auto reward; 5 the full task.

TaskFile.help: The task file in config\, task.yml unless testing.

RewardSizeUl.help: Water per reward. Blank keeps the task file's.

ItiMin.help: Shortest inter-trial interval. Blank keeps the task file's.

ItiMax.help: Longest inter-trial interval. Blank keeps the task file's.

Zapit.help: Optogenetics through the Zapit PC. Off where Zapit is not running.

StepSize.help: How far one spout button moves a spout.

help.RewardLeft: One reward of the current size on the left spout, logged in BonsaiData_Async.
help.RewardRight: One reward of the current size on the right spout, logged in BonsaiData_Async.

help.LeftUp: Raise the left spout by one step size.
help.LeftDown: Lower the left spout by one step size.
help.LeftFront: Move the left spout forward by one step size.
help.LeftBack: Move the left spout back by one step size.
help.RightUp: Raise the right spout by one step size.
help.RightDown: Lower the right spout by one step size.
help.RightFront: Move the right spout forward by one step size.
help.RightBack: Move the right spout back by one step size.
help.BaseLeft: Move the base, both spouts, left by one step size.
help.BaseRight: Move the base, both spouts, right by one step size.

help.SpoutsHome: Drive every spout motor to its zero switch.
help.SpoutsIn: Both spouts to this mouse's In positions.
help.SpoutsOut: Both spouts to this mouse's Out positions.
help.SaveSpoutPositions: Save the spouts' current positions as this mouse's, read at the next Start.
